interactions.teaches: What Vick looked like on the field and in his own words at the plea, after prison and today.
interactions.studentAction: Press play on a video inside the page.
interactions.feedback: The YouTube player starts inside the page.
interactions.staticFallback: Each video has an Open on YouTube link.
interactions.identityFit: Footage sits beside the chapter it belongs to.

interactions.teaches: How the public story and the legal record pulled apart over eight months, and why the judge punished the lying.
interactions.studentAction: Step through nine dated filings or jump to a date.
interactions.feedback: Each entry shows what Vick said in public beside what the record showed, with an ink stamp on the turning points.
interactions.staticFallback: A noscript paragraph lists all nine dates and events.
interactions.identityFit: The control is a docket sheet on court paper.

interactions.teaches: A comeback is many separate decisions by different people over 16 years, and one door stayed partly closed.
interactions.feedback: Each door places a filled or half filled circle on a 2009 to 2026 timeline and shows who decided, the date, what they did and what they said. A tally counts doors opened.
interactions.staticFallback: The door list shows every decision maker and date as text.
interactions.identityFit: Eagles green panel with silver pins, the era when most doors opened.

interactions.teaches: The shape of the career and the two missing seasons at ages 27 and 28.
interactions.studentAction: Switch between rushing and passing yards and press any season.
interactions.feedback: Bars redraw to scale, team colors change at each move, and a season card explains the year.
interactions.staticFallback: A details table lists every season's passing and rushing yards.
interactions.identityFit: Team colors carry the story of where he played. The gap is hatched concrete.
